Subject: Playground token top-up request — FreshML POC

Hi Redwood team,

We hit our free playground quota while running a short POC with a small engineering cohort at FreshML and I’m hoping you can bump our trial so we can finish the evaluation.

Quick context: we signed up yesterday (self-serve) to test the Redwood hosted API for embedding + chat in a proof-of-concept. We’re testing with ~15 engineers and a short prompt set; the account used the credits faster than expected. We’d like an additional 200,000 tokens to complete two more rounds of testing this week — that should get us through the demo to leadership.

Account details:
- Company: FreshML
- Email: sam@freshml.com
- Company size: 45 eng + prod
- Use case: semantic search + chat demo to internal stakeholders

Attached is a screenshot of the playground usage and the account banner showing exhausted credits. Happy to provide billing/account ID or the HubSpot link if you need it. We’re on a tight timeline — demo scheduled Friday 5/7 — so appreciate any fast help.

Thanks,
Sam Patel
CTO, FreshML
sam@freshml.com | +1 (415) 555-0218

Attachments: console-usage-screenshot.png (image/png)
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@freshml.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, dylan_brooks@redwood-inference.com
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Playground token top-up request — FreshML POC

Hi Sam — thanks for the note and the screenshot. I’m Irene on the PLG support/sales ops side; I’ll triage this and aim to get you a fast answer.

Two quick asks to speed approval: can you confirm the account ID shown in the playground (or the sign-up email if different from sam@freshml.com) and whether the usage is primarily embeddings or generation tokens? Also: is the FreshML billing contact (billing@freshml.com) OK to be CC’d for any billing notes?

Policy-wise: we can approve small one-off playground top-ups for evaluation accounts up to an equivalence of ~$300 (typical ~200–300k tokens depending on model). If you need more than that we’ll route to sales for a paid trial boost. If you confirm the account and expected token split I’ll request the top-up and loop Marissa and Dylan for final say.

If it helps, include a short note on expected timeline for the remaining POC steps; I’ll prioritize approvals for demos this week.

Best,
Irene Choi
PLG Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood-inference.com

Irene / Dylan — I looked at the screenshot and Sam’s notes. FreshML looks like a small PLG sign-up (no org commit yet). Approve a one-time trial top-up equivalent to $300 (issue as play credits tied to the account email).

Notes for issuance:
- Amount: $300 playground credit (~200k gen-equivalent tokens)
- Scope: hosted API only; no Dedicated/Private entitlement
- Expiry: 30 days from issuance
- Add a HubSpot note and link issuance to SUP-4217 for tracking

Dylan — can you create the credit in billing and reply-all with the issuance confirmation and internal HubSpot link? Irene, after Dylan confirms, please reply to Sam with the credit details and reiterate the demo ETA question.

-Marissa

Sam — you should see the credit applied within a few minutes. Let me know if you don’t and I’ll escalate. Good luck with the demo on Friday — if you want a quick 15-minute walkthrough of the console or tips on token-efficient prompts I can schedule with one of our solutions engineers.

Best,
